name: echo
longDesc: Prints text or variables to the terminal output. Highly useful in scripting.

flags.description: Do not output the trailing newline

examples.description: Prints Hello World to the terminal

name: date
shortDesc: Print or set the system date and time
longDesc: Displays the current time in the given format.

flags.description: Print or set Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)

name: top
longDesc: Provides a dynamic real-time view of a running system. It can display system summary information as well as a list of processes or threads currently being managed by the Linux kernel.
